title: Electroencephalography (EEG): historical timeline (R-10002)
description: In 1929, Electroencephalography (EEG) entered the record. Electroencephalography (EEG) is a neuroimaging technique of the nervous system. First described in 1929. Its role: records the brain’s electrical activity through electrodes on the scalp. Key fact: the first human EEG was recorded by Hans Berger in 1929.
